The '''Suria system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Kira sector/Legends|Kira sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> within the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="Trailing Sectors" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system was the origin point of the beverage known as [[Surian tea]].<ref name="HonorAmongThieves">''[[Honor Among Thieves]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Surian tea]]|system=Suria [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Suria system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square N-16.<ref name="EAOC" />
